rules.justification: Mesh utilities: facet connectivities, element <-> sub-element adjacency, node -> element maps, groups, clusters, renumberings and periodic pairs are integers computed by deterministic algorithms that reproduce the reference iteration order, so they must be identical. The only real-valued quantities are node coordinates copied from the oracle's read (purify/nodes: a permutation of input/nodes) and the periodic consistency values, which are sums of at most eight dyadic fractions 100/2^k (exactly representable, order-independent): bit-identity is required. Element triples are compared after the declared identity normalisation of upstream's default Element() (type code -2) to the canonical NULL (UD-128). Scope: the current fixtures/mesh_utils corpus only; not a tolerance for arbitrary floating-point periodic sums (UD-132: sorted reduction order, rounding may differ) and not an approval of upstream's inverse facet permutation as the default (UD-122: flips are not part of this corpus).
rules.evidence: 2026-11-10: 53 cases, 1,777 quantities, 329,396 values, regenerated byte-identically by an independent review; 2026-11-11: 55 cases, 1,791 quantities, 329,619 values with the two Diana read cases read/diana_hexa_quad and read/diana_two_hexa (oracle mesh_utils_probe, strict; 45b96e50); crates/akantu-mesh/tests/mesh_utils_oracle.rs::every_mesh_utils_fixture_matches_the_oracle is bit-identical on all 55 cases
rules.reviewed_by: independent review during the port, November 2026
